scope: First-frozen scalar oracle core/proof and selftest/smoke provenance only, before source query checker/adapter/final package review.
method: Read all frozen code and proof; independently derive pi-series, alternating exp, shortcut, rounding and squaring bounds; authenticate first-freeze bytes and static receipts. No scientific program rerun.
universal_conclusion: For rational f>=0 and integer bits>=16, accepted API returns pi and exp(-pi*f) enclosures of requested absolute width; zero/tiny/huge and ordinary branches terminate under exact integer/Fraction contract.

finite_comparison_logic.certifying_direction: Independent oracle interval O subset actual source interval S, because true y in O then y in S.
insufficient_relations: nonempty overlap O intersection S alone
reverse inclusion S subset O alone
finite_comparison_logic.limits: Finite containment certifies only bound queried scalar evaluations; universal source correctness/width needs separate written audit.

independence: First freeze precedes source-generated input queries and numeric outputs; source mathematical method was described in words and explicitly disclosed. Code-disjoint implementation, not human/formal acceptance.
remaining_obligations: Review later input-only query checker/coverage/provenance and source adapter after their freeze.
Bind exact source input/output values and correct subset direction; do not upgrade overlap to enclosure.
